objective: When separately and explicitly launched on an idle A800, stream the frozen H67-ep35/no-running S10 whole-token FFN residual F(x) at the exact post-BN2/pre-parent-ADD boundary, without dumping a full activation tensor or training, so G8 tau=0 and strict positive-tau oracle opportunity plus local norm injection terms become computable.

paper_identity.cohort: the exact first ten frozen valid samples from zurich_city_09_a

ffn_topology.residual_boundary: the full .mlp output is post-BN2 F(x), immediately before the parent block permutes it back and evaluates ADD sew y=x+F(x)
ffn_topology.fc2_boundary: fc2 output is pre-BN2 and is diagnostic only; it is never accepted as F(x)

streaming_capture.token_flat_order: C-order over [T,N,H,W] within one sample/stage/block NPZ
streaming_capture.array_receipt: shape, dtype, element count, byte count and logical-content SHA256 for every array, plus NPZ SHA256 and readback equality
streaming_capture.write_policy: reduce along C on device, transfer only token metrics, immediately write one compressed NPZ after each FFN call

threshold_contract.tau0_rule: skip iff all post-BN2 F channels are numerically exactly zero and every required tensor is finite
threshold_contract.positive_tau_strict_rule: skip iff finite and rho < tau
threshold_contract.boundary_rule: rho == tau is counted separately; inclusive <= count is also emitted and never substituted for the strict count
threshold_contract.qualification: F-based selection is a post-compute oracle; source/MAC saved values are ideal envelopes, not executable cycles or hardware speedup

sensitivity_contract.local_identity: parent y=x+F and oracle y'=x imply delta_y=-F exactly

remote_launch_policy.idle_requires: zero nvidia compute contexts and zero other train/eval/valid/profile Python processes
remote_launch_policy.output_publish: unique partial directory followed by atomic rename only after sealed manifest validation

promotion_after_capture.s10_role: opportunity and norm-injection sweep only; no Delta-AEE
promotion_after_capture.valid825_role: only after a non-trivial S10 point and a separately frozen paired oracle-output-replacement protocol
promotion_after_capture.precompute_predictor: required before any executable skip/cycle claim

red_lines: Do not launch remotely or train during the M460 construction milestone.
Do not use fc2/pre-BN2 output or aggregate density as the FFN residual.
Do not dump a full residual or activation tensor.
Do not call post-compute oracle source/MAC savings executable cycles or speedup.
Do not infer AEE from local F norms without a separately certified downstream sensitivity relation.
claim_boundary: M460 freezes and locally tests a future A800 S10 capture entry. This contract itself admits no GPU capture, skip rate, norm result, Delta-AEE, cycle speedup, energy, PPA, system speedup or headline.
